description: Operational closure state for Commercial V1: a MUTABLE DERIVED PROJECTION, not authority and never outranking the authority, decisions, certifications, observations or evidence it points at. Revision 1 was seeded by CV1-DEVOS-OPUS55-AND-CLOSURE-STATE-R1; revision 2 by its bounded R2 successor under docs/ops/ods/ODS_V1_MAINTENANCE_ADDENDUM_v1.0.39.json. Every value is a pointer re-checkable with pnpm ops:closure-state -- validate --verify-git; revisions may change current disposition but never erase evidence, findings, invalidators, certifications or lifecycle history. docs/ops/release/RELEASE_GATE_LEDGER_v1.0.0.json (canonical gate ledger) wins on any conflict; this projection assigns no ledger gate state. All records are BRANCH_LOCAL / NOT_INTEGRATED at the integration base.
